_comment: Fragment 106 — curated nodes for B-067 (D-168's propagation was still incomplete) and its D-169 correction. Same G109-class extraction gap as every new docs/handoff/ file. Merged 2026-08-31.

nodes.label: B-067: D-168 Propagation and Control-Owner Gaps Remain
nodes.description: D-168 correctly restated FR-11/Line 3's disposition and OD4's deferred-remedy meaning, but five sub-gaps remained where the corrected parent relation had not reached current-value text: the Addendum/Blueprint/Business Case still called the project's own SEC-01 identity rule a Three Lines Model requirement and structural Line separation proof of distinct judgment; OD4's 'Judge = Line 3' default-mapping note stood unqualified in three source documents; the Build Spec opening, FN-EXCEPTIONS-06-11-12 Section 4.2, and Modular_PRD's Q12 closure text retained retired framings; G-05/AS-02/RK-01 named an absent Line 3 as their owner and Q4 tied the detector to excluded FR-11/M5 scope; and DECISION_LOG/CONFIG_LOG still read Q1 as wholly open under OD3 rather than Phase-0-decided.
nodes.rationale: A parent correction that fixes the decision register and the requirement it governs can still leave the same error alive in the surrounding source documents and derived tables -- propagation completeness has to be checked location by location, not assumed from the parent decision's own text.

nodes.label: D-169: D-168's Propagation Completed
nodes.description: Lane A correction closing B-067. Restates SEC-01 as the project's own RACI-sourced rule rather than a Three Lines Model requirement across the Addendum, Blueprint, and Business Case; corrects the claim that structural Line separation proves distinct judgment to name that outcome as OD2, open; removes OD4's unqualified 'Judge = Line 3' default mapping from the three source documents; fixes the Build Spec opening, FN-EXCEPTIONS Section 4.2, and Modular_PRD's Q12 closure text; reassigns G-05/AS-02/RK-01's owner from the non-existent Line 3 to 'no independent owner, FR-14/Line 2 compensating control'; decouples Q4 from excluded FR-11/M5 scope; and separates Q1's decided Phase-0 rule from its open production half in DECISION_LOG/CONFIG_LOG. B-063/B-064 remain Verified, not reopened.
nodes.rationale: Six of the nine locations corrected here predate D-168 itself -- they were never touched by the OD4/Line-3 fix because they describe a different but related error (misattributing a project-owned rule to an external standard, and treating separation as proof rather than mechanism), which is exactly the kind of adjacent drift a parent-first propagation sweep exists to catch before it is mistaken for already closed.
